apps.localizedDescription: PwEevee packages modified Spotify iOS builds (the spoti.pw and EeveeSpotify components, by their own developers) into installable IPAs. Sign with your own certificate when installing: the builds are unsigned. PwEevee is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Spotify or Apple.
